SELECT
  p.name AS director_name,
  ROUND(AVG(m.rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.mid) AS movie_count,
  best.title AS best_rated_film,
  best.rating AS best_rating,
  worst.title AS worst_rated_film,
  worst.rating AS worst_rating
FROM public.m_director md
JOIN public.person p ON md.pid = p.pid
JOIN public.movie m ON md.mid = m.mid
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT m2.title, m2.rating
  FROM public.m_director md2
  JOIN public.movie m2 ON md2.mid = m2.mid
  WHERE md2.pid = md.pid AND m2.rating IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY m2.rating DESC, m2.title ASC
  LIMIT 1
) best
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT m3.title, m3.rating
  FROM public.m_director md3
  JOIN public.movie m3 ON md3.mid = m3.mid
  WHERE md3.pid = md.pid AND m3.rating IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY m3.rating ASC, m3.title ASC
  LIMIT 1
) worst
WHERE m.rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.pid, p.name, best.title, best.rating, worst.title, worst.rating
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.mid) >= 5
ORDER BY AVG(m.rating) DESC;

SELECT year, genre_name, avg_rating, movie_count
FROM (
  SELECT m.year,
         g.name AS genre_name,
         AVG(m.rating) AS avg_rating,
         COUNT(*) AS movie_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.year ORDER BY AVG(m.rating) DESC) AS rn
  FROM public.movie m
  JOIN public.m_genre mg ON mg.mid = m.mid
  JOIN public.genre g ON g.gid = mg.gid
  WHERE m.year IS NOT NULL AND m.rating IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.year, g.name
) sub
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY year;

SELECT

SELECT
    p.name AS director_name,
    ROUND(AVG(m.rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS movie_count,
    best.title AS best_rated_film,
    best.rating AS best_rating,
    worst.title AS worst_rated_film,
    worst.rating AS worst_rating
FROM public.m_director md
JOIN public.movie m ON md.mid = m.mid
JOIN public.person p ON md.pid = p.pid
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT m2.title, m2.rating
    FROM public.m_director md2
    JOIN public.movie m2 ON md2.mid = m2.mid
    WHERE md2.pid = md.pid
    ORDER BY m2.rating DESC, m2.title
    LIMIT 1
) best ON TRUE
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT m3.title, m3.rating
    FROM public.m_director md3
    JOIN public.movie m3 ON md3.mid = m3.mid
    WHERE md3.pid = md.pid
    ORDER BY m3.rating ASC, m3.title
    LIMIT 1
) worst ON TRUE
GROUP BY p.pid, p.name, best.title, best.rating, worst.title, worst.rating
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY AVG(m.rating) DESC;

    FROM public.movie m
    JOIN public.m_genre mg ON m.mid = mg.mid
    JOIN public.genre g ON mg.gid = g.gid

) sub

    JOIN public.m_genre mg2 ON m2.mid = mg2.mid
    WHERE mg2.gid = mg.gid
)

SELECT title, rating, num_votes
FROM public.movie
WHERE num_votes > 1000
ORDER BY rating ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT name AS language_name, title, year
FROM (
    SELECT l.name, m.title, m.year,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.laid ORDER BY m.year DESC, m.title) AS rn
    FROM public.movie m
    JOIN public.m_language ml ON ml.mid = m.mid
    JOIN public.language l ON l.laid = ml.laid
) sub
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY language_name, year DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mg.mid)
FROM public.m_genre mg
JOIN public.genre g ON mg.gid = g.gid
WHERE g.name ILIKE '%Drama%'

SELECT m.mid, m.title, m.year, m.rating
FROM public.movie m
JOIN public.m_genre mg ON m.mid = mg.mid
JOIN public.genre g ON mg.gid = g.gid
WHERE g.name ILIKE '%Comedy%' AND g.name ILIKE '%Romance%'
